mvp_description: Local food market/e-commerce platform for meat/produce

top_buyers.name: Rennick Meat Market
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Established butcher-inspired steakhouse in Ashtabula Harbor on Bridge Street. Featured on Food Network with Alex Guarnaschelli. Known for high-quality steaks, extensive bourbon/whiskey list. Could benefit from online ordering, reservation system, and local producer marketplace features.

top_buyers.name: Harbor Gardens
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Community-focused food market and demonstration kitchen selling sustainably grown local products. Build community around food security and self-reliance. An online marketplace with producer profiles would expand their reach significantly.

additional_contacts.name: Ashtabula Local Food Network
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Coordinates multiple farmers markets and maintains a local food guide with 95+ farms. Digital marketplace tools would support their mission.

additional_contacts.name: Ashtabula County Farm Bureau
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Maintains directory of Farm Bureau members selling direct to consumers. An e-commerce platform would help members reach more buyers.

research_notes: Harbor Gardens has verified Gmail contact. Rennick Meat Market email inferred - phone contact recommended. Both are located on Bridge Street in Ashtabula Harbor.
